existing.description: The LiU International Scholarship is a limited number of tuition-fee reductions awarded by Linköping University to fee-paying international master's students with significant academic potential; the tuition fee of an awardee is normally reduced by 50%. Applicants must have applied in the first admission round, ranked a LiU master's programme first, been admitted to that first choice in the first Notification of Selection Results, and met a minimum academic standard of GPA 3.5 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent. The application window opens on the day the Notification of Selection Results is published and closes a few days later - 26 to 30 March 2026 in the last published round - and no additional documents are required. Awards can cover 30 credits per semester, must be maintained by passing at least 75% of courses in the first academic year, and are rescinded if a Swedish Institute scholarship is awarded instead.
eligibility: Applied for a master's programme at Linköping University by the deadline for the first admission round
Submitted all required documents by the deadline
Ranked a master's programme at Linköping University as first priority (ranked as number 1 of 4)
Admitted to the first choice in the First Notification of Selection Results (usually end of March)
Required to pay tuition fees (citizen of a country outside the EU/EES/Switzerland)
Meet the minimum academic standard: GPA of 3.5 or higher on a 4.0 scale, a first or high second class degree, or an equivalent average
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants to a Linköping University master's programme who applied by the first admission round deadline, submitted all documents on time, ranked a LiU master's programme as first priority (1 of 4), were admitted to their first choice in the First Notification of Selection Results, are required to pay tuition fees, and meet the minimum academic standard (GPA 3.5 or higher on a 4.0 scale, a first or high second class degree, or an equivalent average).
benefits: A tuition-fee reduction for the awarded master's programme, normally 50% of the tuition fee
coverage: A tuition-fee reduction for the awarded master's programme, normally 50% of the tuition fee
requirements: Applications which do not meet the minimum academic standards will not be considered
No additional documents are needed to support the scholarship application
Eligible students are invited to apply by email before the deadline closes
existing.selection_notes: Linköping University reserves the right to determine internally, year by year, how many scholarships are offered, what percentage is offered, and how the merit process is run once eligibility is met and there are more applicants than scholarships. Institutional rankings are considered as part of the evaluation.
existing.best_fit: Fee-paying master's applicants with a GPA of 3.5+ (or equivalent) who rank a LiU programme first and are admitted to it in the first notification round.
existing.notes: Applicants awarded a scholarship by the Swedish Institute have their Linköping University scholarship rescinded. Applicants who cannot obtain a residence permit in time for the start of studies also have the scholarship rescinded. A 2026 recipient list is published as a PDF on the official page.
existing.duration: The specific year and master's programme stated in the Notification of Selection Results, normally covering a 30-credit workload per semester
existing.application_period: Opens on the day students receive the Notification of Selection Results (usually end of March) and stays open only a few days; 26-30 March 2026 for the 2026 round, closing 23:59 CET on 30 March
existing.deadline_display: Official wording: "The application for LiU Scholarships opens each year on the day students receive the Notification of Selection Results, and is only open for a short window. In 2026, the application period is as follows: 26 March - Application period opens. 30 March - Application period will close at 23:59 CET. 10 April - Scholarship recipients will be published on this page." The published dates are for the 2026 cycle; the next cycle's dates are not yet announced.
existing.program_type: University-administered partial tuition-fee scholarship for fee-paying master's students
